description: Which text should we send? Ranked SMS copy for a goal (abandoned_cart, welcome, winback, failed_payment, trial, promo, ... or any) by expected revenue per message, each with its evidence: the factors that moved its score, the closest published SMS-only case studies with source links, and how much comes from this account's own sends (clicks, STOPs, revenue from tracked events). Pass your own drafts in `candidates` to score them against the generated ones. Only uses the offer, code and deadline you give it. Sends and saves nothing.

audience.description: Who gets it, in words, e.g. "opened the paywall and left"

brand.description: Business name as customers know it

candidates.description: Your own drafts to score: a JSON array of up to 10 strings

first_message.description: The first text these people get from the number: the brand and opt-out line are added and counted

first_name.description: Your contacts have first names, so candidates may use {{first_name}}

goal.description: The message type to write, or `any` to compare the types that fit `audience`

limit.description: How many messages to return (default 5, max 20)

offer.description: Optional, e.g. "50% off your first month". Without one no candidate has an offer

product.description: What is being sold, as the customer would say it, e.g. "your second number"

use_history.description: false ranks on the case studies only

name: recommend_message
title: Recommend message
